description: Writes a results report, the same as Reports in Taseli: the last 28 complete days (the app's window) or the last full month, for the owner or written for the business's client (no budget or bid talk), from Taseli's records: results by week and campaign, what Taseli did and why, what comes next in the plan, the creatives, what it learned. Saved as a draft in Taseli; `share` also makes a private read-only link. Takes up to a minute and uses Taseli's AI; changes nothing in any account.

audience.description: owner (default) or written for the business's client (agencies).

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

range.description: 28d (default: the last 28 complete days) or the last full calendar month.

share.description: true: also make the private read-only link to send someone.

name: make_report
title: Make a results report
